turns.text: Copper Wok Eastside, good evening. How can I help you today?
I'd like to order the sesame green beans and the shrimp fried rice and the pad see ew for delivery please.
One thing: my wife is allergic to dairy. Is that a problem?
Of course. So we're checking for dairy, for your wife, right?
I checked our allergen list: the sesame green beans has no dairy listed, though it's prepared in a shared kitchen, so cross-contact is possible.
Sure. What's the full delivery address?
You're inside our delivery zone. That's sesame green beans and shrimp fried rice and pad see ew, $40.50 with the delivery fee. We'll text you when the driver leaves.
Can I get a name and phone number for the order?
